content.body:
With twenty kilograms of TNT explosive and eight grenades, sappers carry a significant amount of destructive power. Satchels could damage or immobilize nearly all armored vehicles in the early war, if the sapper could get close enough to place the charge.
Engineers can also repair bridges and this is one of their often overlooked abilities, critically important when bridges are crucial to the success or failure of the attack.
